top_rule_sample.antecedent: ROSES REGENCY TEACUP AND SAUCER, PINK REGENCY TEACUP AND SAUCER
top_rule_sample.explanation: Rule: [ROSES REGENCY TEACUP AND SAUCER, PINK REGENCY TEACUP AND SAUCER] -> [GREEN REGENCY TEACUP AND SAUCER]. Support = 2.10% of all 18,532 orders contained both items. Confidence = 89.4% of customers who bought the antecedent also bought the consequent. Lift = 23.99x means the pair occurs 23.99 times more frequently than if purchases were independent.

definitions.support: Frequency of itemset co-occurrence across all transactions (P(A and B)).
definitions.confidence: Conditional probability that consequent B is bought given antecedent A (P(B|A)).
definitions.lift: Ratio of observed co-occurrence to expected co-occurrence under statistical independence (P(B|A) / P(B)). Lift > 1 indicates positive association.
definitions.caveat: Association rules show statistical correlation and co-purchase affinity, not direct causal proof or guaranteed future purchases.
